cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before I open the scholarship letter, do we have clean teaspoons?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made your tea. Open it; I want to know if you're leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You've put sugar in mine. I'll need another cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take mine. Are you frightened of going, or staying here with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If we swap cups, how will you know which has sugar? We need labels before anything gets mixed up.

mechanism: A conditions opening emotionally loaded news on increasingly exact tea arrangements, approving practical diversions to exclude the underlying choice fear.
confusable: D86 avoids why a relationship changed; D110 hides a present underlying fear by continually focusing on logistics.
comparison: Scholarship news and sugar cups differ from moving-out train checks and platform access.
seedUse: Use D110-a B already-made tea and offered cup becoming another labeling demand; practical solutions must fuel the evasion.
